agencyName: Utah Division of Occupational and Professional Licensing (DOPL) & Oregon Building Codes Division
authorityRationale: The actual signed, bilaterally-executed interstate reciprocal agreement (BCD# 73-0-452) between Utah DOPL and Oregon's Building Codes Division, made pursuant to ORS 670.380 and Utah Code 58-1-302. Not a summary or third-party description — the literal governing document itself, naming both agencies as co-signing parties and stating the exact journeyman and master/general-supervising conditions verbatim. Hosted on Oregon's own .gov domain (the Utah-side equivalent pages were persistently blocked to automated fetch), but the document's authority derives from Utah DOPL's own signature on it.
reliabilityRationale: A jointly-executed government agreement, directly quoted from the raw PDF text — the highest reliability class, matching the Colorado regulation-text and Arkansas rules-PDF precedent.
